assumptions.thermal: p0 temp offset A=k*hard_threshold_C, k~U(0.75,2.5); p1 gets 0.8*A (shared cooling, p0/p1 corr 0.99 in data); offset passes a first-order lag (EWMA span 6) to mimic thermal inertia; rounded to 1 C (sensor resolution).
assumptions.fan: fan speed multiplied by (1 - m*d), d~U(0.10,0.30); either fan0 only or both fans (50/50); rounded to 100 (sensor resolution). Synthetic fan speed may fall below the observed idle floor (4200) because a degraded fan is by definition out-of-envelope.
assumptions.fan_thermal_coupling: ASSUMPTION (not verified): reduced airflow raises both processor temperatures by 20 C * m*d * load_fraction (load_fraction in [0,1] from causal CPU-power EWMA); same thermal lag.
assumptions.power: ps0_input_power multiplied by (1 + m*a), a~U(0.10,0.40), p0/p1 power untouched (input power not explained by CPU power); total_power shifted by the same absolute delta times the data-derived slope of total_power on ps0+ps1 (=0.9344); rounded to 10 (resolution).
assumptions.profiles: gradual (linear ramp 30-70 samples, p=0.7) or abrupt (3-sample ramp, p=0.3); hold; recovery with p=0.5 (20-40 samples) else persists to window end; power 'spike' variant uses abrupt ramp, hold 8-20, recovery 3.
assumptions.combined: two distinct components out of {thermal, fan, power}, onsets differ by 0-20 samples.
assumptions.labels: synthetic_label = 1 iff injected intensity m >= 0.20; severity stage 0:<0.2, 1:0.2-0.5, 2:0.5-0.9, 3:>=0.9 (abrupt faults jump to 3). Stage is injected-effect intensity, NOT time-to-failure or RUL.
